title: Truly best, Fabulous, Unique
body: Fabulous app is the best app I have ever used in my life to build habits, pursue dreams, and living in abundance and I’m constantly evolving with app. I am so grateful for God, and thanks to developersor whoever worked behind this app. What I like best about it? It has no ads or pop-ups even in standard version. I deleted all other apps like mediation, exercise, habit trackers, goal trackers, motivation and so on. Now I have only Fabulous and recommended to 200 people in my personal blog. May God help you in what you do everyone and be happy, achieve all your dreams. One more thing, design is awesome, everything is done perfectly and asap I can afford sphere, will purchase to see what’s difference. Once more, Love you Fabulous from Uzbekistan
author: Ahmadjon07

title: Просьба и пожелания
body:
Очень полезное и хорошее приложение.Только есть большой минус, в настройках нет русского языка.Из-за этого трудно прослушать  мотивационные текста и иногда я испытываю трудности в переводе заданий 
Пожалуйста, добавьте русский язык
